title: We-Math Construction Pipeline and Diagnostic Evaluation Protocol

nodes.label:
5-Tier Hierarchical Knowledge Tree
99 Knowledge Nodes & 67 Terminal Mathematical Concepts
Structured Across Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Statistics & Logic

Visual Math Problem Harvesting
Authoritative Exams, Competition Archives & Textbooks
Collects 6,524 Candidate Geometry and Arithmetic MCQs

Image-Text Consistency & Single Answer Gate?
Verifies Non-Ambiguous Ground Truth and Essential Diagram Dependency
Checks That Problems Cannot Be Solved Without the Visual Figure

Inconsistent / Ambiguous Item Discard
Prunes Multi-Answer, Non-Visual, or Text-Only Solvable Questions
Guarantees Strict Multimodal Visual Grounding

Triple-Expert Independent Concept Annotation
Three Mathematical Scholars Assign Underlying Knowledge Concepts
Annotates Step-by-Step Formal Proof and Minimal Step Count

At Least Two Experts Agree on Concept Mapping?
Requires Majority Consensus (>= 2/3) on Concept and Difficulty
Resolves Inconsistencies Through Adjudication Panel

Subproblem Modular Decomposition
Decomposes Composite Multi-Step Problems into Fine-Grained Subtasks
Isolates Individual Concept Components for Diagnostic Probing

We-Math Official Testmini Benchmark
1,740 Frozen Evaluation Items with Granular Concept Cards
Stratified: 1,215 One-Step, 360 Two-Step & 165 Three-Step Problems

Standardized Multimodal Problem Presentation
Pairs High-Resolution Diagram with Question Text and Answer Options
Evaluates Model on Both Holistic Problem and Dissected Subproblems

Autoregressive Multimodal Inference
Visual Foundation Models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini, Qwen2-VL)
Greedy Decoding Generating Reasoning Trace and Option Choice

Option Regex Extraction & Formatting Check
Extracts Predicted Option Letter [A-E] from Solution Text
Normalizes Unstructured Answers into Symbolic Option Keys

Composite & Subproblem Prediction Correctness?
Evaluates Joint Prediction Tuple: (Subproblem Correctness, Composite Correctness)
Identifies Discrepancies Between Core Concept Knowledge and Synthesis

4-Quadrant Cognitive Diagnostic Classification
IK: Insufficient Knowledge · IG: Inadequate Generalization
CM: Complete Mastery · RM: Rote Memorization / Lucky Guessing

Diagnostic Failure / Guessing Analysis Sink
Quantifies Hallucinatory Rote Memorization and Generalization Bottlenecks
Feeds Fine-Grained Error Attribution by Mathematical Subject

Diagnostic Score Calculation Engine
Computes Weighted Composite Index: Score = alpha*IK + beta*IG + CM
Default Weights: alpha=0, beta=0.5 (Rewarding Partial Generalization)

We-Math Official Metric Reporting
Reports 4-Dimensional Metrics (IK, IG, CM, RM Percentages)
Overall We-Math Diagnostic Score Across 5 Hierarchy Levels and 67 Concepts
